highlights.text: Run agents from channels, group chats or direct messages, with thread replies continuing the same session.
Share connector accounts with specific groups, specific people or everyone in a project.
Mobile push notifications alert you when a turn completes, fails, asks a question or needs permission, even while the app is closed.
Saved transcripts and attachments load without waking the sandbox.
Sessions retry transient model errors and continue through short provider outages instead of stopping.
Connect your computer from the desktop app, with access approval and a tunnel that keeps running while the app is closed.
Fork a conversation from any point in a session.
Share a secret or connector account with an agent across all its sessions, triggers and schedules.
Failed triggers show their reason on the Schedule page and send one push notification when a failure streak starts.
Edit queued prompts in place in a dedicated card above the composer.
Send a message with Enter to steer a running turn at its next step without stopping it.
Each answer shows which model responded and what it cost.
Credit usage shows which trigger, member or caller spent it.
Security settings list every signed-in device, and signing a device out stops its access immediately.
Create a skill from a form without using a model.
Restore deleted sessions for 30 days, or continue a session on a new computer with its saved conversation, images and files.
Agents can answer with visual cards, comparisons, photo steps, product cards, maps and figures on web and mobile.
Pin and archive sessions to keep your list organized.
Large folders load in pages, and file search finds content as well as names.
Beta app event triggers can run an agent when something happens in a connected app, such as a new email or opened pull request.
Share a finished assistant response through a public link, with or without its prompt, and turn off anonymous access at any time.
Move a project to another account or organization.
Pause all account automations with one switch, and use trigger run history to inspect errors, test triggers and replay runs.
Retry failed reminders from the session, project list or calendar, with the last error visible.
Upload, view and manage files in a shared drive with team folders, accessible from the app and command line.
